title: Analysis code and derived data for: Assessing Precision3D satellite photogrammetric elevation models for forest canopy height retrieval
description: Analysis code (R and Python) and derived site-level and forest-type-level tables supporting the manuscript 'Assessing Precision3D satellite photogrammetric elevation models for forest canopy height retrieval' (submitted to the ISPRS Open Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing, 2026). The code compares the Precision3D digital surface model, digital terrain model and canopy height model with airborne lidar at GEDI footprints across 18 US sites, fits Bayesian hierarchical models of the errors and tests corrections at held-out sites. The archive contains no Vantor Precision3D imagery or delivered elevation rasters and no per-footprint proprietary values. Versions 1.0.x archive the analysis of an earlier version of the manuscript.
